set.body: From the cold review of 23db27133 (F1, F5). The producer takes characters from role-labels.json without checking them against the in-scope Name - All entries, so an extra name silently widens the dialogue vocabulary. Refuse a listed character absent from the rows, slug collisions in visual or proposal ids, and two characters that fold to the same name (otherwise list order breaks the tie). Real run complies.
set.title: S3c-2 follow-up: validate the reviewed vocabulary against the in-scope rows
